DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 83 s. 2022 AUG 11 2022 JOHN REY L. MOSQUITO, J.D. Provincial Director DILG Region XIII (CARAGA) — Surigao del Norte Capitol Compound, Surigao City Dear Prov. Dir. Mosquito: This has reference to your letter dated 04 August 2022 regarding your request for clarification concerning the conduct of Philippine Councilors League (PCL). At the outset, as to Sec. 8 of Resolution No. 02 issued by the Philippine Councilors League (PCL), which is submitted for this Department's interpretation, while it appears that there is a conflict as to who shall finally determine and specify the venue and time of the election because of the phrase 'the notice and invitation for all Councilors for the Provincial Federation/City Chapter/RegionaI Council Elections shall come from the DILG Provincial Director/ DILG City Director/DlLG Regional Director, respectively, in consultation with the PCL Local Chapter President/s", it is actually subject to reconciliation. Accordingly, we deem it proper to highlight that this Department is the topmost government agency which maintains coordination with, and exercises supervision over local government units (LGUs) and its multi-level leagues. Note however that, the extent of such authority cannot go beyond the sphere of general supervision and shall not constitute direct interference with the political affairs, of the LGUs. In view thereof, as an entity exercising general supervision over the LGUs and the Leagues, this Department's authority is limited to seeing to it that the rules are followed, but it cannot lay down such rules itself, nor does it have the discretion to modify or replace them. This is precisely the rationale on why the phrase "in consultation with the PCL Local Chapter President/s", was included, as the venue and time and place of election are governed by the League's internal organization and operation. Hence, it is the PCL Local Chapter President/s, and not the DILG Provincial Director/ DILG City Director/DILG Regional Director, who shall determine and specify the venue and time of the election, for to do so is tantamount to control and a clear and direct interference by this Department with the political affairs the LGUs and its officials, in effect giving this Department more power than the law or the Constitution grants. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Correspondingly, the role of this Department is limited to the actual giving out of notice and invitation containing the specific details that has been determined by the PCL Local Chapter President/s, to all Councilors for the Provincial Federation/City Chapter/Regional Council Elections, considering this Department's authority over LGUs and the Leagues. Very respectfully yours, BY THE AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARL GAN Undersec ry for Local Government OSEC/BDCA/LLLS-LRALLD/rjki COPY FURNISHED. LILIBETH A.
